name: @algomaker/api
description: Desk bridge: accepts the Python desk's actions, routes them (paper or live), marks the book and computes greeks, exposes positions/trades/diff.
_comment:mongodb: Declared in dependencies below, not only at the root: `src/mongo.ts` is the ONE file in the tree that `require('mongodb')`s and it lives in this workspace, so a workspace that owns the driver adapter without declaring the driver is one `npm install --workspace` away from a boot-time MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The exact pin is deliberate — see the header of `src/mongo.ts`.
